title: Fragment Unification · Complete Manifestation
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji thought victory was within reach, that golden vertical pupil suddenly expanded, like a deep abyss tearing through the heavens—the ultimate alarm of the Heavenly Eye had fully descended.

text.content:
The golden vertical pupil hung in the void, cold and authoritative, as if the eternal heavens themselves. The voice that was about to speak ten thousand years of truth stopped abruptly, turning into a lingering echo that dissipated in the collapsing ruins.

Chen Ji stood in place, five fragments floating and circulating around him, emitting light that varied between bright and dim. He slowly raised his head, gazing directly at that lofty vertical pupil, a meaningful smile curving his lips.

"You've arrived just in time." His voice was unnervingly calm, "If you'd been a moment later, I was afraid you'd have missed this grand show."

dialogue.content:
Within the vertical pupil, golden light churned, and a voice devoid of any emotion directly crashed into Chen Ji's soul: "Mortal, you dare test the heavens' bottom line?"

Deep within the ruins, stones floated upward, heavenly spiritual energy turned chaotic like boiling water, and the entire space trembled slightly under this pressure.

Yet Chen Ji remained unmoved. He raised his hand, five fingers spread open, allowing the five fragments to slowly rotate above his palm.

text.content:
"Test?" Chen Ji let out a light laugh, "If I wanted to test, why would I let that voice say so much?"

He took a step forward, foot symbols exploding beneath him. The first page of the Tianji Record—the one containing Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul—suddenly blazed with dazzling silver light.

"I'm merely confirming one thing." Chen Ji's voice was low and certain, "Confirming that you... truly would intervene."

The vertical pupil constricted slightly. From within that silver light, an aged voice began to sound—the words Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul hadn't spoken completely in ten thousand years: "...The Tianji Record never recorded fate, but the rules that bind fate. And the rule-makers have never feared being recorded, but being..."

dialogue.content:
"Copied."

Chen Ji took over, his eyes flashing brilliantly. He suddenly flipped his palm, all five fragments converging toward his chest—no, toward some invisible point within his body.

"Generations of prophets thought the Tianji Record was a supreme treasure for glimpsing heavenly secrets, yet they didn't know its true purpose—" Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of mockery, "—was to become a key. A key that can unlock shackles—and these shackles, were forged by your own hands."

The ruins' core shook violently. The formation patterns that had sealed the ancient earth for countless ages began to flash frantically.

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, his eyes slightly closing. The silver glow of the first page, the cyan radiance of the second, the purple lightning of the third, the golden splendor of the fourth, the crimson flames of the fifth—the five-colored brilliance converged within his body, like five streams rushing into the sea.

Intense pain struck.

It wasn't physical pain, but the loosening, breaking, and reshaping of some deep-rooted shackle deep within his soul. Each fusion was like carving new brands onto his spirit, each transformation accompanied by the rapid consumption of Heavenly Fate Value—

【Heavenly Fate -50】

Remaining Heavenly Fate: 23/100.

But Chen Ji did not retreat. What he wanted was never to eke out a miserable existence.

"Chen Xuan walked to this point back then, yet fell short at the final moment." Chen Ji murmured, as if speaking to Mo Xiansheng, or to himself, "He lacked not strength, but the courage to risk everything—and I, lack nothing."

The instant the five fragments completely merged, silence fell upon heaven and earth.

The vertical pupil suddenly contracted into a thin line, and within those lofty golden eyes, an unprecedented—astonishment?

dialogue.content:
"Shackles and keys have always been two sides of the same coin."

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, each pupil reflecting a rune—the supreme mark only the complete Tianji Record possessed: the unified symbol of 'Fate's Shackles' and 'Portal Key'.

His voice echoed in the silence, each word like thunder: "You used the Tianji Record to bind generations of prophets, treating them as chess pieces for countless ten thousands of years. Yet you forgot—"

He raised his right hand, and in his palm, an ancient yet complete scroll slowly manifested. Golden book with jade pages, two magnificent characters shining on the cover—

【Tianji Record · Complete Version】

"—chess pieces can also overturn the chessboard."

text.content:
"—Chess pieces can also overturn the chessboard."

The ruins completely collapsed. Endless storms of spiritual energy swept from all directions, yet the moment they approached Chen Ji within three feet, they transformed into the purest heavenly元气, devoured completely by that complete Tianji Record.

The vertical pupil trembled. That cold voice sounded again, but this time carried undeniable fluctuation: "...What exactly are you?"

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, five-colored brilliance flowing around him like dragons and serpents. He looked at that lofty vertical pupil, his eyes holding no fear, no reverence—only a calm bordering on pity.

"What am I?" he softly repeated, "I am Chen Xuan's inheritor, the author of the Tianji Record, am—"

He paused, his smile deepening: "—the key forged by your own hands, prepared to turn against its master."

"No... this is impossible!" Golden light surged within the vertical pupil, "The Tianji Record was created from the source of heavenly way, how could a mere Foundation Building mortal—"

"How could understand its true usage?" Chen Ji interrupted, his voice carrying a playful tone, "You forgot one thing. The reason the Tianji Record chose the Chen bloodline wasn't because we could peer into heavenly secrets for you, but because—"

He raised the complete golden book in his hand, gently opening the first page. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged, an aged face showing a relieved smile.

"—because we were your original creators." Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, "The Tianji Record was something you stole from us."

The vertical pupil abruptly froze.

From deep within the ruins came a deafening rumble. The ancient formation patterns that had sealed the earth for millennia completely shattered, revealing an abyss of unfathomable depth—and within that abyss, a towering stone gate was slowly manifesting.

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his palm. On the first page of the complete Tianji Record, besides Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, new text had also emerged:

【Method to Break the Boundary (Incomplete): Attack shackles with shackles, break fate with fate. Use oneself as the guide, burn all heavenly fate, and open this gate.】

【Required Heavenly Fate: All.】

Chen Ji stared at those words, then suddenly laughed.

"Burn through all Heavenly Fate, forcibly open this gate..." he murmured to himself, "So this was the path Chen Xuan never completed."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed softly: "This is the only way to break the situation, but the price is your life. Young man, you—"

"Who said I have to die?"

Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze piercing through that golden vertical pupil, as if seeing the more massive consciousness behind it.

"The true usage of the complete Tianji Record, I only just comprehended." His voice became low and dangerous, "This shackle—I don't need to destroy it, I only need to..."

He turned to the last page of the Tianji Record, and above that golden seal, gently placed a finger.

"...Rewrite its rules."

dialogue.content:
"Golden light surged within the vertical pupil, and that cold voice finally carried undeniable fury: "Presumptuous!"

An apocalyptic pressure descended from the heavens, transforming into tangible golden chains that swept toward Chen Ji like a overwhelming tide—that was the direct manifestation of heavenly laws, the ultimate form of fate's shackles.

Yet facing this power sufficient to obliterate everything, Chen Ji merely gently raised the golden book in his hand.

Above the cover of the complete Tianji Record, those two characters suddenly illuminated: 【Heavenly Secrets】

"You forgot one thing." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "The Tianji Record records the rules of heaven and earth. And from today onward—"

Using his finger as a pen, he wrote new words on the last page of the Tianji Record: "—the one holding the pen, has changed."

text.content:
The instant Chen Ji set down his pen, the golden vertical pupil in the void suddenly expanded—not contracted, but frantically expanded, as if tearing apart the entire heavens.

"Ding—"

A crisp sound came from the Tianji Record. Chen Ji lowered his head to see the newly written words slowly fading, replaced by a line of ancient runes never seen before.

【Heavenly Fate Shackle Released: Shackle Essence Being Rewritten...】

【High-Dimensional Consciousness Interference Detected—Forced Interruption】

Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed.

Meanwhile, that golden vertical pupil had expanded to an incredible size, nearly filling the entire sky. Within the deepest part of the pupil, a presence more concentrated and terrifying than any before was brewing.

That was the ultimate alarm of the Heavenly Eye.

That was—the gaze of an even higher existence, pressing down like something tangible.

Chen Ji looked up at that vertical pupil nearly obscuring the heavens, yet a faint smile curved his lips. He knew the true test was just beginning.

But he was not afraid.

Because he finally understood the ultimate secret of the Tianji Record—the so-called shackles and keys were originally two sides of the same coin. The fate's shackles forged by the Heavenly Eye were both bindings and the only key capable of breaking them.

And now, in his hand, was a pen sufficient to rewrite rules.

"Come then." Chen Ji spoke softly, his voice not loud yet clearly reaching every corner, "Let me see what other cards you, the so-called heavens, are still hiding."

Above the heavens, the golden vertical pupil grew increasingly solid. And within its deepest pupil, an even more ancient eye was slowly opening—

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, pouring all remaining Heavenly Fate within his body into the Tianji Record. The golden book and jade pages suddenly burst with dazzling light, strands of golden chain illusions emerging from around him—those were the primordial forms of the heavenly shackles.

"How many generations of my Chen family did you imprison with these shackles?" Chen Ji coldly laughed, "Today, let you taste the flavor of shackles turning against their maker!"

Golden chains shot into the sky, rushing directly toward that sky-obscuring vertical pupil.

"From this day forward—" his voice echoed within the collapsing ruins, "Fate's Shackles shall no longer be an unsolvable死局."

text.content:
Chen Ji did not act rashly. He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record rapidly turning in his palm, countless scenes flickering through his mind like a parade.

Three breaths later, his eyes snapped open: "Found it."

In the instant that larger eye within the Heavenly Eye fully opened, he saw the flaw it contained—that was the winning opportunity he had been waiting for.
